summary:
PyreCast FireWatch is a real-time wildfire intelligence platform that transforms raw NASA satellite telemetry into clear, actionable risk insights for emergency responders, land managers, and the public.

While standard satellite maps flood users with raw, overlapping thermal detections from multiple orbiting sensors, PyreCast uses an H3 spatial harmonization engine to fuse MODIS and VIIRS data into a single, standardized hexagonal grid. It automatically eliminates duplicate fire counts, normalizes Fire Radiative Power (FRP), and compares live burning activity against a 10-year historical baseline to highlight true statistical anomalies allowing teams to distinguish routine agricultural burns from critical wildfire threats at a glance.
details: PyreCast Firewatch is a website that monitors wildfires using satellite data, interactive maps, charts, and AI. Its goal is to improve fire awareness, promote prevention, and protect the environment. The project uses NASA FIRMS data and Netlify, combining technology and creativity to make wildfire information easier to understand. Our team considered accuracy, accessibility, safety, and environmental impact.
